mapper.select: SELECT card_id,revision,repo_id,title,card_type,content,tags,knowledge_kind,severity,enforcement, owner_account_id,scope_payload::text AS scope_payload, obligations_payload::text AS obligations_payload,last_verified_content_version,verification_note, publication_status,changed_by,changed_at FROM knowledge_card_revisions WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND card_id=#{cardId} ORDER BY revision DESC

SELECT card_id,revision,repo_id,title,card_type,content,tags,knowledge_kind,severity,enforcement, owner_account_id,scope_payload::text AS scope_payload, obligations_payload::text AS obligations_payload,last_verified_content_version,verification_note, publication_status,changed_by,changed_at FROM knowledge_card_revisions WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND card_id=#{cardId} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_cards SET title=#{source.title},card_type=#{source.cardType},content=#{source.content},tags=#{source.tags,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, knowledge_kind=#{source.knowledgeKind},severity=#{source.severity},enforcement=#{source.enforcement}, owner_account_id=#{source.ownerAccountId},scope_payload=CAST(#{source.scopePayload} AS jsonb), obligations_payload=CAST(#{source.obligationsPayload} AS jsonb), publication_status='DRAFT',review_status='UNREVIEWED',reviewed_by=NULL,reviewed_at=NULL, source_version_status='UNVERIFIED',verified_commit=NULL,source_version_checked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_verified_content_version=NULL,verification_note=NULL, revision=revision+1,updated_by=#{actorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND id=#{cardId}
mapper.select: SELECT id,repo_id,title,card_type,content,tags,knowledge_kind,severity,enforcement, owner_account_id,scope_payload::text AS scope_payload, obligations_payload::text AS obligations_payload,last_verified_content_version,verification_note, publication_status,revision,created_at,updated_at, verified_commit,source_version_status,source_version_checked_at,review_status,reviewed_by,reviewed_at FROM knowledge_cards WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND id=#{cardId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_code_refs(card_id,revision,position,repo_id,content_version,chunk_id,file_path,symbol_name,start_line,end_line,content_hash,branch_id) SELECT card_id,#{targetRevision},position,repo_id,content_version,chunk_id,file_path,symbol_name,start_line,end_line,content_hash,branch_id FROM knowledge_code_refs WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND card_id=#{cardId} AND revision=#{sourceRevision}
